mapping_contract.activities: Explicit canonical ID -> one or more observed labels; unions sum counts and use earliest anchor. Never guess from similar spelling.
mapping_contract.case_attributes: flow_type required; automation fields optional and require validation.

flow_values.invoice_bearing: Explicit mapped flows with invoice evidence expected; consignment must be reviewed separately.

mapping_contract.case_notion: PO item; adapt and review for other units

interpretation: All added rules and weights are draft threshold/applicability proposals requiring review; business ownership and approval are unspecified.
Affected cases are not event counts; cases are not necessarily unique business documents.
Do not infer manual work, time saving or labor cost from identity, event counts or elapsed calendar intervals.
Clearing is not independently verified payment; repetition is not duplicate payment.
No contractual-lateness claim without invoice-specific terms and actual settlement.
Service, framework, recurring and consignment patterns require context review; screens are not defect rates.
Timestamp comparisons use strict < or >; equal-time event positions do not prove business chronology.
Legacy constraints and scores remain unchanged and retain their original caveats.

gaps.reason: Installed constraint primitives do not encode adjacency in the recorded sequence. The separately labelled broad repetition screen cannot reproduce the reported 626 cohort.
Need actual arrival/readiness and document links; completed single-event lag excludes repeated/missing/reversed pairs and is not an AP queue or open-age measure.
Terms, due dates and actual bank settlement unavailable; generic clearing interval cannot substitute.
Need allocations, signed reversals, document IDs, cross-line matching; case event count/balance is insufficient.
Validated eligibility/execution/recovery fields required for optional metric. Resource identity is not evidence of labor; explicit transfer failures cover only a narrow interface question.
Authorization/commitment history and amendment reason records unavailable; occurrence/chronology only.

local_reproduction_note: Thresholds, explicit mappings and executable tests are implementation proposals. Run-specific counts and parity checks are local evaluation outputs, separate from original report evidence; different populations are not claimed as reproductions.
